page: Microsoft Azure D2plds_v5 is an ARM-based virtual machine configuration within the general purpose DPLDSv5 family, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 3.0 GHz, providing 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs with single-threaded execution per core. Cache configuration includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. Memory allocation provides 4.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a compute-oriented 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Local storage is directly integrated, featuring an 81 GB solid-state drive.

Benchmark assessments show steady entry-level performance tailored to lightweight environments. In single-core CPU stress testing via stress-ng, the instance achieves an average score of 1821.98, while multi-core throughput rates at 3613.27. Standard integer and cryptographic operations benefit from hardware AES acceleration, achieving a single-threaded gzip compression speed of 24.16 GB/sec. Across broader synthetic metrics, Geekbench evaluates single-core execution at 1095.0 and multi-core execution at 2010.0, with Clang software compilation reaching 2640.0. Cache-adjacent small block memory bandwidth sustains 140.8 GB/sec, tapering to 26.37 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 16.5 GB/sec for writes.

The instance delivers a cost-efficient profile for scale-out architectures that require dedicated execution units rather than burstable or hyperthreaded cores. Because memory is limited to 4.0 GB and advanced vector extensions such as AVX are absent on the ARM Neoverse-N1 microarchitecture, high-density vectorized math and heavy analytical memory operations face structural constraints. Furthermore, in-memory operations like Redis record 2.83 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput measures 2.66 GB/sec.

The Microsoft Azure D2plds_v5 is suitable for lightweight services, including microservices, small local build tasks, low-footprint background workers, small-scale caching layers, and entry-level ARM application testing.
description: Microsoft Azure D2plds_v5 is an ARM-based virtual machine configured with an Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor running at 3.0 GHz. The system provides 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores, 4.0 GB of system memory, and an integrated 81 GB local SSD. It includes dedicated L1, L2, and L3 caches along with cryptographic hardware AES support. Benchmark results reflect entry-level performance, achieving a single-core stress-ng score of 1821.98, a Geekbench single-core mark of 1095.0, and 2.83 million Redis SET operations per second. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the configuration is constrained for high-memory workflows but provides consistent execution without hyperthreading contention. Microsoft Azure D2plds_v5 is well suited for running lightweight microservices, continuous integration build workers, ARM development pipelines, and basic edge or staging web services.
